digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Surface-parity census must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) and disposition each as in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason
Each config key the change reads must have a test proving it changes behavior through the real read path via default vs non-default contrast, not merely parsing validation

Contention trigger cases (composed locked ops, check-then-act writes, retry-reclamation logic, cache-over-store-state) must route to existing shared test suites by shape: two_clones, storm, or reads-under-sync-contention harness
Behavioral gate findings must be captured by a RED test first in the same change before the fix is applied
Residual-gap disposition sweep must enumerate all out-of-scope slots and deferred items, marking each as filed, accepted-with-reason, or fixed
